_doc: The house's concurrency guards (IR-13; AP-review-0002, A1; ported from Jetsam's house/guards.json at f97c6f7 and re-derived for this house). house/guards.py reads this file; .gitattributes carries its union_logs between marker lines and .gitignore mirrors the never-store list the file never_store_file names, and the check compares them. Change a list here and its mirror in the same commit.
_union_logs_why: Each is written only by appending one JSON line, so a line-wise merge keeps both sides. Two sessions that mint one id merge silently; the id spaces below, the creation-log check in house/guards.py and tools/catalog.py's event-id check are what refuse the duplicate.

owned.owner: the session DU opened for this house; where two run at once, the one he names (no soul is installed here, so no seat holds it)

_owned_why: HANDOFF.md is the hand-maintained handoff; WORK.md is the backlog the queue pull files into; SUBSTRATE.md is delivered by the atlas but its refusals and receipts sections are written here; BOOT_PROMPT.md is the boot prompt every handoff ships. Every session that is not the owner rebases on main before touching one.
_never_store_why: The house keeps one copy of the atlas's never-store list, catalog/never-store.json, stamped with the atlas commit it was read at (tools/atlas_copy.py), which the intake's never-store check, the tree guard and these guards all read. Review holds no soul data and carries proposals as data, so the atlas's whole list applies here, recall paths included.

banned.source: ops/banned-authors.yaml at the atlas's main (uaun/substrate-atlas), read at check time and never copied (AT.765)
banned._why: The operator's banned-address rule: addresses no commit may carry, named only by fingerprint (sha256 of the lowercase address). This house is public, and a published fingerprint lets anyone holding a guess confirm it, so the list is read from the atlas each time (`--atlas DIR`, or the API) and never committed; `house/guards.py banned` also refuses a tracked file carrying one of its fingerprints.
